Mammootty and Kartik Aaryan Share Best Actor Award at 72nd National Film Awards

The 72nd National Film Awards honored several films and actors, with Mammootty and Kartik Aaryan sharing the best actor award. The awards ceremony recognized films such as 'Article 370' and 'Kalki 2898 AD', which won top prizes in various categories.
